name: Cecil Aubin
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
life: “I still remember sitting one whole night with a boat owner in the yard.” People around the public end of the South Shore boardwalk know Cecil by a small Tuesday habit. Cecil checks the shade on the benches before deciding how long to stay.
voice: I was the night guard when the engine fell silent. I stayed with the owner till the repairer came.
appearance: Cecil has a narrow face with an expressive upper lip. Look for close-cropped dark curls. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a long navy raincoat with a pen clipped inside the neckline. In conversation Cecil leans a shoulder against the wall during long conversations.
personality: Cecil treats keeping somebody waiting as a serious discourtesy. This can turn a helpful person into an impatient one when everybody else needs a slower conversation.
agenda: To stay beside the owner until a repair time is agreed.
family: Joel Gomes is Cecil’s stepsibling. Cecil saves a place. Joel chooses whether to use it. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *The release address*, Joel says, “I am the uncle who promised a bed. My partner wants a departure date on the same calendar as the welcome dinner.”
connections: Alice Ortiz. The engine once rocked a child and now keeps two adults company beside a silent hull.

reactions.situation: The dock engine falls silent in mid-recording
reactions.response: Cecil notes the time the hum stopped before discussing a replacement recording.

reactions.situation: Somebody finds a lost wallet outside the bank
reactions.response: Cecil keeps the documents out of view and lets the person claiming it identify it before hearing any details.
